title: Global Warming Health
definition: The study of how anthropogenic climate change, driven by greenhouse gas emissions, alters environmental determinants of health, leading to direct and indirect morbidity and mortality.
importanceInUpsc: High relevance in GS Paper III (Environment/Disaster Management) and GS Paper II (Social Justice/Health Policy). Frequently linked to SDGs (Goal 3 and 13).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Global Warming Health.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
